segments.en: I am usually out of town and would like my calls to be forwarded to a local number.
segments.zh: 我通常不在城里，希望将我的电话转接到本地号码。

segments.en: Yes, of course.
segments.zh: 是的，当然。

segments.en: We can activate all these services in about an hour.
segments.zh: 我们可以在大约一个小时内激活所有这些服务。

segments.en: So talking about all these services, it's very interesting because many of these services are not really available everywhere in the world.
segments.zh: 所以说到所有这些服务，这很有趣，因为这些服务中的许多服务并不是在世界各地真正获得的。

segments.en: Like for example, voicemail.
segments.zh: 例如，语音信箱。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So in China, no one really has voicemail.
segments.zh: 所以在中国，没有人真正拥有语音信箱。

segments.en: It's very strange for an American because you think, well, if I'm not home, I want to know why this person called.
segments.zh: 对于一个美国人来说，这很奇怪，因为你认为，好吧，如果我不在家，我想知道这个人为什么打电话。

segments.en: But oftentimes, you just have to call back and find out.
segments.zh: 但通常，您只需回电并找出答案。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: And actually, I really think that voicemail service is a very good thing, especially if you need to leave a message for someone.
segments.zh: 实际上，我真的认为语音邮件服务是一件非常好的事情，特别是如果您需要为某人留言。

segments.en: You know, hey, we're at the restaurant.
segments.zh: 你知道，嘿，我们在餐厅。

segments.en: Call me back when you have a chance.
segments.zh: 有机会的时候给我回电话。

segments.en: But also, call waiting.
segments.zh: 而且，呼叫等待。

segments.en: I really, really hate to call someone and have the busy tone.
segments.zh: 我真的，真的很讨厌打电话给某人并且有忙碌的语气。

segments.en: And then you know that they're on the telephone, but you don't know when they will stop talking on the phone.
segments.zh: 然后你知道他们在打电话，但你不知道他们什么时候会停止打电话。

segments.en: This really annoys me too, especially when I call for delivery food from a restaurant.
segments.zh: 这也真的让我很恼火，尤其是当我从餐厅要求送餐时。

segments.en: It's like, please answer your phone.
segments.zh: 就像，请接听您的电话。

segments.en: But maybe someone's ordering a lot of food.
segments.zh: 但也许有人点了很多食物。

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So actually, these services are very common in the United States.
segments.zh: 所以实际上，这些服务在美国非常普遍。

segments.en: And I'm sure there are even more services now.
segments.zh: 我敢肯定现在有更多的服务。

segments.en: I know that you can have a telephone number, for example, in another country, but it'll ring in the United States.
segments.zh: 我知道你可以有一个电话号码，例如，在另一个国家，但它会在美国响起。

segments.en: Yeah, that's right.
segments.zh: 对，没错。

segments.en: Or you can connect your computer and your messaging service and all these things to your phone.
segments.zh: 或者您可以将您的计算机和消息服务以及所有这些内容连接到您的手机。

segments.en: So it's pretty technologically advanced.
segments.zh: 所以技术上还挺先进的。

segments.en: But I'm very curious to know about you guys, our listeners, what kind of services for your cell phone or for your landline do you have?
segments.zh: 但我很想知道你们，我们的听众，你们的手机或固定电话有什么样的服务？

segments.en: Do you have call forwarding or voicemail?
segments.zh: 你有电话转接或语音信箱吗？

segments.en: Let us know.
segments.zh: 告诉我们吧。

segments.en: Our website is EnglishPod.com.
segments.zh: 我们的网站是 EnglishPod.com。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: We'll see everyone there.
segments.zh: 到时候见，各位。

segments.en: Bye-bye.
segments.zh: 拜拜。
